map_features.note: Selected southwestward Oyashio corridor south of Bussol Strait, followed by the first intrusion along eastern Honshu, to an OSW nominal gate at 40 N. Alternative southern gates use seasonal index limits at 38.5 N in April and 41.5 N in December. Excludes upstream East Kamchatka Current, Sea of Okhotsk circuits, offshore return branch into Subarctic Current, eastward Oyashio Extension/front and detached eddies. This branch convention is not the complete Oyashio system.
